summary:
AgriVision is a smart agriculture project that uses *NASA's SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive)* mission and *NISAR (NASA–ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar)* data to help farmers understand soil conditions. SMAP measures and maps soil moisture over large areas, helping monitor changes in the amount of water in the soil. NISAR provides additional detailed observations that can support agricultural and soil-moisture monitoring.

The satellite data is processed to identify changes in soil moisture and provide updated soil-condition information. The AgriVision mobile app presents this information in a simple form, helping farmers understand whether soil conditions are dry or moist. Farmers can use these insights to make better irrigation decisions and avoid unnecessary watering. By connecting *space-based data, data processing, and a mobile app*, AgriVision aims to support smarter irrigation, reduce water wastage, and promote healthier and more sustainable farming.
details:
AgriVision: From Space to Soil is a smart agriculture app that helps farmers make better irrigation decisions using NASA Earth-observation data. The project uses soil-moisture information from NASA's SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) mission, which measures and maps soil moisture. We also consider NISAR, the joint NASA–ISRO mission, as an additional source of detailed soil-moisture information. NASA Science

The app processes soil-condition data and displays it in a simple, farmer-friendly format. Farmers can check whether conditions are dry or moist and use the app to make irrigation decisions. A connected smart irrigation controller can also allow the farmer to remotely manage a water pump.

The project aims to reduce over-watering, unnecessary irrigation, and water wastage, while helping prevent delays in irrigation that may affect crop health. Our intended impact is to make complex space data useful in everyday farming and support more sustainable water management.
